supersededBecause: The published packet's skill order and five-path source vector compose a Claude first line past the Flow 0.17.x 800 UTF-16 limit; Start refuses it before reservation.

flowNexusProfile.instruction_prompt: you are the Psyche Fable successor of 8904b1; remember it at depth one and b7ba00 at depth two; the source names your handoff and packet.

composition.note: The bundle file name is the launch request's 16-hex short form (LaunchBundles::file_for_request over ShortensLaunchRequest::SHORT_FORM_LENGTH = 16), so the name length is fixed whatever the request ID is. The directory is not: it is the serving Nexus's HOME plus .local/state/flow/launch-bundles. flow-nexus-next.service sets HOME=/home/li/.local/state/flow-next, so the live Flow-next bundle directory is /home/li/.local/state/flow-next/.local/state/flow/launch-bundles and the generated path is 91 characters, not the 68 this packet previously modelled. Three real generated bundles of that length were observed there. A deployment with another HOME changes the count and the line must be remeasured.

measurement.method: LaunchComposer::compose was run for real against this exact profile in a temporary root, then the temporary source and launch-bundle-copy paths were substituted back to /home/li/primary/flows/38f337/fable-launch/sources.md (53 characters) and /home/li/.local/state/flow-next/.local/state/flow/launch-bundles/launch-<16 hex>.md (91 characters). has_canonical_first_prompt() was true; CR and LF counts were both zero.
